thread:
Alex: Heads-up — planning cross-service cutover tomorrow 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. API -> v2.0.0, runtime kernel 3.4.2, console schema ordering change, router header-split toggle. Need pin/rollback plan and deploy-bot gating.
Priya: Can API + runtime be pinned together? worried router header split might expose old runtime kv layout.
Jorge: Router header split is a traffic toggle only. Runtime 3.4.2 changes KV encoding for long sequences; if router flips early we could see 502s from old runtime. Suggest pin runtime first.
Alex: Proposed sequence: 1) Pin console (keep old schema) 2) Deploy runtime 3.4.2 (canary 5%) 3) After KV warmup enable router header_split gradually 4) Upgrade API.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot triggered: scheduling window 2026-03-18T02:00Z. Canary plan [5%,25%,50%,100%]. Auto-rollback on sustained 5xx spike >1.5x baseline for 3m.
Priya: Need traffic cushion first 15m — recommend headroom 2x and watch latency P95. Ops: can we reserve +1 runtime shard for canary?
SRE-Oncall: I can reserve +1 shard and enable auto-burst for the window. Adding temporary alert with runbook.
Jorge: Draft release notes: API: /v2 endpoints + deprecation warnings. Runtime: kernel 3.4.2 (kv-encoding, watch seq>2048). Console: saved filters order change. Router: header-split flag + sticky session cookie. I'll paste in #release-notes.
Alex: Rollback criteria (short): API 5xx rate >2% absolute or >2x baseline for 3m; Runtime 5xx/KV errors >0.5% or OOMs; Router causing 502s or P95 latency >1.5x baseline. On trigger: revert router toggle then rollback runtime pin and API.
Priya: Who runs router toggle rollback? I can, but need exact command. Paste snippet pls.
Jorge: Command: `curl -XPOST "https://deploy.internal/api/toggle?service=router&flag=header_split&state=off" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"`
Priya: Good. Canary schedule: 5% for 10m, 25% for 10m, 50% for 10m, then 100% — manual hold at each step if SLOs not met.
SRE-Oncall: Alerts/runbook: https://internal/runbooks/runtime-canary. Reserving capacity now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot created rollout for alex. Pins: console=v1.12.3, runtime=v3.4.2, api=v2.0.0 (deferred). Canary windows: [5,25,50,100] with 10m holds.
Alex: Preflight checklist: release notes posted; changelog in console; oncall confirmed; runbook linked; capacity reserved; rollback commands posted and copied to incident doc.
Priya: Draft release notes: https://internal/release-notes/2026-03-18-cutover — please review before EOD.
Jorge: Tagging API team for swagger compatibility check @Michael — any breaking contract changes needing client migration notes?
Michael: Only stricter header validation; clients with malformed metadata will get 400. Added migration note in draft. No client runtime changes required.
Alex: Plan locked. I'll kick deploy-bot in the quiet window. If no objections in 30m, we proceed. :thumbsup:
Priya: :+1: ready.
SRE-Oncall: Oncall watching dashboards and standing by for manual capacity changes.
Jorge: I'll monitor kernel rollout and KV metrics.
deploy-bot: Note — if runtime canary fails deploy-bot will auto-pin previous runtime and notify #eng-oncall.
Alex: Moving to preflight. Last call for blockers?
